title: 野村张宇：宁德时代盈利不及预期，税收与竞争双重压力
speaker: Ethan Zhang

segments.en: You're taken the earnings from C-A-T-L, first and foremost. Yeah, thanks for having me here.
segments.zh: 首先，你看了宁德时代的业绩。是的，感谢邀请。

segments.en: So to be honest, the earnings is below the market expectation and my expectation as well.
segments.zh: 老实说，业绩低于市场预期，也低于我的预期。

segments.en: So the revenue is actually well on track. Actually, we see it's in line with the shipment growth.
segments.zh: 营收其实符合预期，与出货量增长一致。

segments.en: However, what has been missing the market expectation would be the bottom line. Where we see it's a decline in the quarter of a quarter.
segments.zh: 然而，不及市场预期的是净利润，我们看到环比下降。

segments.en: So I want to highlight a couple of potential reasons. So first, the changes in the revenue mix
segments.zh: 我想强调几个潜在原因。首先，营收结构变化。

segments.en: as the management also commented on the NS code that they shipped more so-called low value at products or solutions during this quarter.
segments.zh: 管理层在业绩会上提到，本季度出货更多低价值产品。

segments.en: So we actually believe that could be the domestic energy storage market, which is quite competitive right now with very fierce price competition.
segments.zh: 我们认为这可能是国内储能市场，目前竞争激烈，价格战激烈。

segments.en: So that margin is actually below its average margin level. And secondly, I want to highlight that there is some text change.
segments.zh: 因此利润率低于平均水平。其次，我想强调一些税收变化。

segments.en: Starting from April, there is a cut in the export VAT text refund rates.
segments.zh: 从4月开始，出口增值税退税税率下调。

segments.en: So it is not fully reflected in second quarter because there is a time difference between the shipment and actual revenue cognition.
segments.zh: 由于出货与实际收入确认存在时间差，二季度未完全反映。

segments.en: And now it's fully reflected in Q3. And also starting from September, China starts to levied the 2% battery consumption tax on all the domestic battery sales.
segments.zh: 现在三季度已完全反映。此外从9月起，中国对国内电池销售征收2%消费税。

segments.en: That's well list to extra text burdens on all the battery suppliers. So all this combined, I guess, the combined impact is just the bigger than the market expected.
segments.zh: 这给所有电池供应商带来额外税收负担。综合影响大于市场预期。

segments.en: Previously, market makes back some shares sharing between the battery suppliers and the car makers in terms of the extra text burden.
segments.zh: 此前市场预期电池供应商与车企会分担额外税收负担。

segments.en: But at least by third quarter, it is not happening yet. I guess it's still subject to the further negotiation, maybe fourth quarter next year.
segments.zh: 但至少三季度尚未发生，可能还需进一步谈判，或许在明年四季度。

segments.en: So basically, that's my take on the results. And what was your take on the mood on the earnings call?
segments.zh: 这就是我对业绩的看法。你对业绩电话会议的情绪有何看法？

segments.en: What was the sense of management there? Were they worried? Were these known knowns? Was this transitory?
segments.zh: 管理层的态度如何？他们担心吗？这些是已知风险吗？是暂时的吗？

segments.en: Or are there new challenges that seem to be calcifying around the company?
segments.zh: 还是公司周围正在形成新的挑战？
